name: run_shell_command
description: Execute a shell command on the user's computer. Use this to open applications, manage files, run scripts, get system info, or perform any task that can be done in a terminal. Prefer this over computer_use for anything that can be done via command line.

parameters.description: The shell command to run on the user's computer. On macOS use zsh syntax (e.g. 'open -a Discord'). On Windows use PowerShell syntax. Chain multiple steps with &&. Extract the intent from the user's request and form the appropriate command.
